description: This Java class, ProductImageSizeUtils, provides utility methods for resizing BufferedImage objects, with options for simple resize, resize with hints, and resize maintaining aspect ratio.

classes.name: ProductImageSizeUtils
classes.description: Utility class for image resize functions

methods.name: resize
methods.description: Performs a simple resize of an image without maintaining aspect ratio.

methods.name: resizeWithHint
methods.description: Resizes an image using specified rendering hints, optionally performing multiple passes for higher quality.

methods.name: resizeWithRatio
methods.description: Resizes an image while maintaining the aspect ratio based on specified width and height constraints.
